impact: Recovers much of BE's recent slide; the AI power trade stays tied to neocloud financing news, so Nebius's Thursday report and yields are the next tests for BE.
source: Seeking Alpha / 24/7 Wall St. / Yahoo Finance
summary: Bloom Energy rose about 17% to roughly $217 on Wednesday as CoreWeave's results eased worries about how data-center build-outs get funded. FuelCell Energy climbed about 5%. Bloom is still down about 24% over the past month but up about 145% year to date.
title: Bloom Energy surges ~17% as CoreWeave lifts AI power stocks
